definitions: A type of generative model that learns a compressed representation (latent space) of data and can generate new, similar data points.
Neural networks that use an encoder-decoder structure to learn a probabilistic mapping from data to a latent distribution and back, enabling data generation and dimensionality reduction.
examples: Variational autoencoders are widely used in image generation.
The research focused on improving the stability of variational autoencoders.
Understanding the latent space of variational autoencoders is key.
